product.name: Photo Album Kit
product.description: An editable Canva photo album template at eight by six inches landscape — four guided pages (right-hand and left-hand versions of two layouts: a full-page hero and a two-photo stack), with the 0.75 inch gutter keep-out already placed on the correct inner edge of every page and the photo frames sitting inside the half-inch safe margin. Duplicate the pages to reach your twenty. Plus the gutter and safe-zone map, the twenty-page planner, the photo resolution checking sheet, a fill-in-the-blanks print-shop brief that asks the layflat question for you, the binding guide quoted from Canva's own page, and six spread layout recipes (Genius Junkie)
